name: Delete environment group
description: Delete environment group Delete the environment group with the provided ID, including all environment variables and secret files it contains. DELETE /v1/env-groups/{envGroupId}

name: Remove environment variable
description: Remove environment variable Remove a particular environment variable from a particular environment group. DELETE /v1/env-groups/{envGroupId}/env-vars/{envVarKey}

name: Remove secret file
description: Remove secret file Remove a particular secret file from a particular environment group. DELETE /v1/env-groups/{envGroupId}/secret-files/{envVarKey}

name: Link service
description: Link service Link a particular service to a particular environment group. POST /v1/env-groups/{envGroupId}/services/{serviceId}

name: List environment groups
description: List environment groups List environment groups matching the provided filters. GET /v1/env-groups
context:
GET /v1/env-groups
List environment groups matching the provided filters. If no filters are provided, all environment groups are returned.
Optional: name (query) — Filter by name; createdBefore (query) — Filter for resources created before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); createdAfter (query) — Filter for resources created after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); updatedBefore (query) — Filter for resources updated before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); updatedAfter (query) — Filter for resources updated after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); ownerId (query) — The ID of the workspaces to return resources for; environmentId (query) — Filter for resources that belong to an environment; cursor (query) — The position in the result list to start from when fetching paginated results. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).
